summary: Frontend retest of the About the Group fixes from iteration 17. All 4 fixes work. (1) HANGING /api/content (held open 20s, localStorage cleared): both paragraphs appeared 7.16s after goto started. That is about 1s of page load plus the 6s axios timeout. Text is the current default 'Founded in Indonesia... / Our strength is built on...', with no raw markers (**, [c=, [align) and justify alignment on desktop. (2) ABORTED /api/content with no cache: paragraphs visible in 0.96s and the fallback body2 starts with 'Our strength is built on...' (no longer 'Our approach'). (3) Normal reloads: desktop 1920x800 passed 5/5 in 0.68-1.30s, with CMS text, text-align justify, opacity 1, no .line-mask spans on title or paragraphs, and title height equal to scrollHeight (not clipped). Mobile 390x844 passed 3/3 in 0.63-0.68s, with text-align left, title fully shown and no LineReveal. The Cloudflare challenge was not hit (10 navigations in total).

issues: The bundled default EN about.title in translations.js line 86 is 'From conventional roots to sustainable future growth.', but the CMS value is 'From conventional roots to a sustainable future'. When the API fails or hangs, the fallback title differs from the CMS title. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: update translations.js en.about.title to 'From conventional roots to a sustainable future' so the fallback matches the CMS.
critical_code_review_comments: LanguageContext content fetch now has timeout 6000 and a finally that sets contentReady, so the earlier never-renders bug is fixed.
Paragraph className 'text-left md:text-justify' is applied only when align === 'justify'. Other alignments use inline style. Correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Simulate a hang with page.route('**/api/content', handler that sleeps 20s), after localStorage.clear(). Test ids: about-para-0/1, about-para-mobile-0/1, about-title, about-title-mobile. Keep reloads to about 10 or fewer to avoid the Cloudflare challenge.
